# Singapore Business Trip Plan: 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-22

A convenience-first plan for **1 traveler**, optimized for **low transit time**, **carry-on only**, and **2 client meetings per day**. I’ve assumed you want a **central business hotel near an MRT station** and that hotel pricing is for the full 3 nights.

## Best Hotel Options Near MRT for a Short Business Stay

| Option | Area | Why it fits | Est. total for 3 nights | MRT access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **YOTEL Singapore Orchard Road** | Orchard | Very central, efficient rooms, easy for quick movement | **~$390–$450** | **Orchard MRT** nearby |
| **ibis Singapore on Bencoolen** | Bugis/Bencoolen | Strong value, practical for meetings, central east-west access | **~$330–$420** | **Bencoolen / Bugis MRT** nearby |
| **Hotel Mi Bencoolen** | Bencoolen | Compact, modern, good for business routing | **~$360–$450** | **Bencoolen MRT** nearby |
| **Mercure Singapore Bugis** | Bugis | Good balance of comfort and location | **~$420–$480** | **Bugis MRT** nearby |

### Recommended pick
**ibis Singapore on Bencoolen** is the best fit if your top priorities are **budget control + central location + fast MRT access**.
If you want a slightly more polished business feel and can spend closer to the top of budget, **YOTEL Singapore Orchard Road** is the strongest convenience option.

## 3-Day Client-Friendly Itinerary

### Day 1: Arrival + Downtown Meetings
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and settle near your hotel/MRT.
- **Afternoon:** Client meeting 1 in **Raffles Place / Marina Bay** area; keep lunch nearby to avoid cross-city transit.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/ae/1_singapore_national_day_parade_2011_fireworks.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Client meeting 1 in **Raffles Place / Marina Bay** area; keep lunch nearby to avoid cross-city transit, Singapore
- **Evening:** Client meeting 2 in **City Hall / Bugis** area, then simple dinner near hotel.
- **Food:** Quick business dinner at a hotel restaurant or hawker center close to your MRT stop.
- **Overnight:** Stay central near **Bugis, Bencoolen, or Orchard**.

### Day 2: East-West Core Meetings
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Client meeting 1 in **Shenton Way / Tanjong Pagar**.
- **Afternoon:** Work block or second meeting in **Orchard / Somerset / Dhoby Ghaut** depending on client location.
- **Evening:** Client meeting 2 in a central area, then return directly to hotel.
- **Food:** Fast lunch at a mall food court for predictable timing.
- **Overnight:** Same hotel to avoid packing/moving.

### Day 3: Final Meetings + Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- **Morning:** Client meeting 1 near your most important account or closest CBD node.
- **Afternoon:** Client meeting 2 with a 60–90 minute buffer before airport transfer.
- **Evening:** Head to Changi with extra time for traffic and check-in.
- **Food:** Light lunch, then airport meal if needed.
- **Overnight:** Depart or stay only if your flight is next day.

## Carry-On-Only Packing List

### Work essentials
- 2–3 business shirts/blouses
- 1–2 trousers or skirts
- 1 blazer or lightweight jacket
- 1 pair of comfortable business shoes
- 1 backup top for long meeting days

### Travel essentials
- Passport, ID, boarding pass, wallet
- Phone, charger, power bank, universal adapter
- Laptop/tablet, charging cable, mouse if needed
- Toiletries in 100 ml containers
- Medication, glasses/contacts, small umbrella

### Smart extras for Singapore
- Breathable fabrics for heat and humidity
- Foldable tote for documents or samples
- Small deodorant and blotting wipes
- Socks/undershirt backup for all-day meetings

## Budget Check

| Category | Target | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Flight | **Up to $1,200** | Economy should be manageable from most major hubs; book nonstop if possible |
| Hotel | **Up to $450 total** | Aim for **$150/night or less** before taxes if possible |
| Ground transit | **Low** | Use MRT and short rides only when meetings are outside core MRT reach |
| Meals | **Moderate** | Hawker centers and mall food courts keep costs predictable |

## Quick Actions
